rawContent: There is a fundamental wrong in the assumption that an assault must be reported immediately. How hypocritical of people. If you are not in that person’s position, how can you know the circumstances.  #MeToo
There can be situations in which a victim is to traumatize to tell their story. Imagine you’ve just been sexually assaulted. All assaults are victimizations, but sexual assault is different. #MeToo
There is a part of that person that is violated internally. Its not your property, your person, or home, its you. Your soul, internal privacy, and sexual being is forcibly taken from you. #MeToo

You have no control over the event and you can never get what’s been taken back. You can never heal. Now society tells you that right after this you need to immediately go tell, but you can barely move for days, you are in shock. #MeToo

Maybe you go on with your day, but you are just going through the motions. You possibly ask someone what you should do, they don’t want to be involved, or they tell you have you considered what everyone will say. #MeToo

Possibly you’ve seen someone else who told their story and watched them be on trial instead of their accuser. You get up the courage after a week to tell, or possibly you tell immediately. You’ve played out the scenarios. #MeToo
After the assault you immediately go, no rape kit is done. You ask why, and you are told there are no visible signs, so you don’t need one, or maybe after you insist you get one. #MeToo
